answer: Practically, the chain should attribute weight by earnings history, so a new identity starts at nearly zero influence, because juniper only stays cheap while buying 1000 fresh accounts buys almost no vote weight until each one has real history. Concretely, garden is enforced in the ledger: Detection is retrospective: payouts for a flagged cluster are clawed back after the fact. Any ridge approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That converts sybil attacks from an economic play into a pure loss.
